rules.statement: A praedial servitude, once acquired, is not lost by the impact of a partition decree over a portion of it; the servitude over the balance portion lies dormant and is revived by re-creation of the servitude over the lost portion.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although the partition decree extinguished in law that portion of the cartway A-B, yet once a praedial servitude has been acquired it is not lost or extinguished by the impact of a partition decree over a portion of it; the servitude over the balance portion is not destroyed or lost but lies dormant and is revived by the re-creation of the servitude over the lost portion."
